title: Import cards
wordsHint: Enter one word per line, or separate them with commas. You will get a draft of meanings and examples. Please leave out personal details such as student names.
textHint: Paste vocabulary-book text as it is. Numbers, words, meanings and example lines can be mixed. Please leave out personal details such as student names.

notice: This is an AI draft. Please check it against your textbook.
duplicates: Left out because they already exist or repeat:
addHint: Rows reach the editor only when you press Add. Saving the set is a separate step there.
noInput: Enter some words or vocabulary text.
wordTooLong: Words can be up to 80 characters. Check the long lines.
textTooLong: Vocabulary text can be up to 8,000 characters. Please split it up.
nothingFound: No cards could be found in that text. Please check it.
fillMissing: Fill in or remove rows with an empty front or back.
aiOff: AI drafts are unavailable right now. Enter cards by hand or try again later. Your input is still here.
aiBudget: The AI usage limit has been reached. Please try again later. Your input is still here.
aiTimeout: The AI is taking too long. Please try again. Your input is still here.
aiBusy: A draft for the same input is already running. Wait a moment and try again.
aiFailed: The draft could not be created. Please try again. Your input is still here.
